name: Dawn Embrace
summary: A low mosque sits inside a broad rising-sun halo, held by one shared axis.
why: The sun is a large, intentional enclosing arc rather than a small corner decoration. Generous gaps preserve the mosque dome and both tower profiles, while the sunrise brings warmth to the moment of prayer.
risk: The reduced sun is an open halo; some viewers may first read a protective arch.

palette.name: DAWN EMBRACE / PLASTER + EARTH + WARM GOLD

reasonToChoose: You want the peaceful feeling of the beginning of a prayer day.
